g.text: Larger-cohort gains are consistent across the eight diagnostic parents
Each point compares the same parent with its original P1 model · negative change is better · horizontal scales differ
RMS change = 100 × (revised / original − 1). Parent values average six intervals and four withheld directions.
Eight development parents, two per morphology family; no bootstrap interval or independent-confirmation claim.
